title: Satin Chrome Towel Bar, 30-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Traditional, Allied Brass
description: Bathroom towel bar, 30 inches / 30-inch / 30in wall mount design for hanging and drying towels in Satin Chrome, which provides a brushed, matte-like surface that resists fingerprints while maintaining a modern, understated elegance. This wall-mounted towel bar (also searched as a towel rack, towel holder, or towel rail) features solid brass construction and a traditional straight bar look from the Carolina collection. Mounting is 30 in center-to-center with a 0.75 in bar diameter. Concealed screw mounting hardware creates a clean, finished appearance and helps keep classic bath accessories looking coordinated. Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4". Supports up to 10 lb. Available in multiple lifetime designer finish options. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass Carolina Collection.
